title: Climate-Resilient Land Use Governance in Coastal Tamil Nadu: Policy Framework & GIS Evidence
author: Dr. R. Sundaram, Prof. M. K. Ananth
organization: Indian Institute of Technology Madras & NITI Aayog Policy Cell
summary: This study evaluates the impact of rising sea levels and extreme weather events on agricultural land conversion in coastal districts of Tamil Nadu. Using high-resolution Sentinel-2 satellite imagery and revenue land records, the authors propose a socio-ecological zoning model for land allocation.

title: Digital India Land Records Modernization Programme (DILRMP): Comprehensive Evaluation Report 2024
author: Department of Land Resources (DoLR)
organization: Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India
summary: Official evaluation of computerization of Rights of Records (RoR), digitization of cadastral maps, and integration between sub-registrar offices and land revenue departments across 28 states and 8 Union Territories.

title: Resolving Land Disputes through Blockchain and AI-Based Mutation Auditing in Uttar Pradesh
author: Dr. Amitabh Sharma, Er. Priyanka Verma
organization: National Institute of Public Finance and Policy (NIPFP)
summary: Proposes an automated smart-contract auditing system to eliminate double allocation of Gram Sabha lands and reduce court backlog in Revenue Courts of Uttar Pradesh by 35%.

title: Urban-Rural Land Transition & Agricultural Preservation in Bengaluru-Mysuru Industrial Corridor
author: Karnataka Land Policy Institute
summary: Examines the conversion of fertile agricultural land for real estate and industrial hubs along the Bengaluru-Mysuru expressway, emphasizing spatial buffer zones and land pooling mechanisms.

title: The Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013: A Ten-Year Legal Audit
author: Law Commission of India & Centre for Land Governance
summary: Comprehensive legal audit of LARR 2013 implementation, judicial interpretations, SIA effectiveness, and compensation payout delays across infrastructure projects.
